fixes.problem: hercule-whitehaven-run-1x.png (297, 333, 1132, 209): node subtitles and connector conditions are too small to read comfortably at the displayed 80% zoom.
fixes.change: Set the displayed minimum size of node titles and subtitles to 12px with 16px line-height, and connector labels to 11px with 16px line-height. Apply these minimums after graph zoom. Use node padding of 12px horizontally and 8px vertically.

fixes.problem: hercule-whitehaven-run-1x.png (1003, 420, 437, 43) and (297, 456, 140, 40): future and inactive graph nodes are dimmed until labels and connectors nearly disappear.
fixes.change: Set node and connector group opacity to 1. Use oklch(0.52 0.012 80) for secondary node text and oklch(0.65 0.012 80) for node borders. Distinguish states with a displayed 12px outlined mark and explicit Pending or Not triggered text.

fixes.problem: Repeated faint supporting text appears in hercule-whitehaven-intake-1x.png (291, 527, 395, 33), hercule-whitehaven-settings-appearance-1x.png (21, 343, 234, 185), hercule-whitehaven-sidebar-1x.png (21, 343, 234, 346), and hercule-whitehaven-thread-1x.png (495, 865, 722, 15).
fixes.change: Set secondary text ink to oklch(0.52 0.012 80) at opacity 1 for workspace labels, timestamps, work summaries and explanatory footers. Verify at least 4.5:1 contrast against each actual background.

fixes.problem: Small supporting roles repeat in hercule-whitehaven-intake-1x.png (324, 318, 360, 12), hercule-whitehaven-sidebar-1x.png (21, 343, 234, 346), and hercule-whitehaven-thread-1x.png (522, 181, 218, 15).
fixes.change: Use font-size 12px, line-height 16px and font-weight 400 as the minimum metadata role for source details, times, workspace labels and author lines.

fixes.problem: hercule-whitehaven-thread-1x.png (522, 205, 714, 59): assistant prose repeatedly exceeds the comfortable 60–75-character measure.
fixes.change: Set assistant prose max-inline-size to 64ch and line-height to 22px. Measure the rendered paragraphs against the 60–75-character target.

fixes.problem: Thread titles lose distinguishing information in hercule-whitehaven-settings-appearance-1x.png (21, 267, 234, 99), hercule-whitehaven-sidebar-1x.png (21, 267, 234, 207), and hercule-whitehaven-thread-1x.png (21, 598, 234, 18). Status or duration shares the title line.
fixes.change: Allow thread titles up to two lines at 13px font-size and 18px line-height. Move status and duration to the metadata row. Use auto row height, 8px vertical padding, 12px horizontal padding and a 4px title-to-metadata gap.

fixes.problem: hercule-whitehaven-settings-appearance-1x.png (49, 731, 54, 81): Ada, Juno and Milo use neutral name ink despite their visible iris, orchid and teal colleague hues.
fixes.change: Use the existing iris crew hue for Ada's name, orchid for Juno's and teal for Milo's, at opacity 1 and font-weight 500. Verify each name's text contrast on the sidebar surface.

fixes.problem: hercule-whitehaven-intake-1x.png (924, 186, 203, 18): the branch value marta/webhook-backoff → main uses the code face rather than the UI face.
fixes.change: Use the existing UI font family for branch values, at font-size 12px, line-height 16px and font-weight 400.

summary: The run graph needs legibility work: tiny labels and heavily faded pending nodes obstruct reading. The other Hercule screens have clear actions and warm character, with repeated weaknesses in supporting text and truncated titles.
